nft_do_chain is still using old generation (it will skip the newly added
rules)

column2: it would not cause a crash but

same packet
To resolve this
column2: add rule pointer array holding two generations

column1: current one and the future generation.
In commit phase
column2: allocate the rule blob and populate it with the rules that
